summary: Preserve uninitialized lexical bindings across ESM cycles so early reads throw ReferenceError.

target.notes: Binding cells need an uninitialized state distinct from undefined/null and must throw before initialization.

semantics.tdz: uninitialized lexical export read throws ReferenceError
semantics.cycle: linking can succeed while evaluation later hits TDZ

caveats: C# field defaults such as null/0 would incorrectly hide this error.

tests.name: early cycle read throws
tests.expected_behavior: evaluation fails with ReferenceError from uninitialized binding

tests.name: cycle without early read succeeds
